Maximum capacity (Emax)11000 kg up to and including 55000 kg

Accuracy ClassC

Maximum number of load cell intervals (n)4500
Ratio of minimum LC Verification interval
Y = Emax / vmin		18000
Ratio of minimum dead load output return
Z = Emax / (2 * DR)		4500
Input impedance750 Ω ± 50 Ω
Temperature range-10 °C / + 40 °C

Humidity ClassCH
